summary: SERTEX Mobile FAZ B2 Wave 3 (Görev Bağlama / task groups) + Wave 4 (Görev Kilidi + OTP) verified end-to-end on Expo web preview at mobile viewport 414x896 as admin serkan. All 6 requested behaviors PASS. WAVE 3: (a) 'Bağla' toolbar button [tasks-link-open-button] opens [link-tasks-modal]; save is aria-disabled=true with <2 selections; selecting via [link-add-<id>] (21 candidates listed), setting [link-group-name], toggling [link-show-progress], reordering via [link-move-up-<id>], and [link-save] all work; group persists. (b) On tasks list, group badges [task-row-group-badge-<taskId>] render with name+progress e.g. 'Grup-1785945467 0/3' for all 3 new members. (c) Task detail [task-detail-group-section] shows group name uppercased 'GRUP-1785945467' + '0/3 tamamlandı' badge + ordered members ([task-detail-group-member-<id>] × 3) with current highlighted, [task-detail-group-edit] + [task-detail-group-dissolve] visible; dissolve API call succeeds. WAVE 4: (d) [task-detail-lock-section] renders with status chip 'Serbest'; opening [task-detail-lock-config-open] shows exactly 13 [task-detail-lock-flag-<key>] checkboxes matching LOCK_KEY_ORDER; [task-detail-lock-set-all]/[task-detail-lock-clear-all] toggle all correctly; [task-detail-lock-requires-otp] switches between strict/soft; [task-detail-lock-config-save] persists → after save section text updates to 'Kilitli' + 'Düzenleme (başlık / açıklama)' + 'Silme' active-lock chips + soft-lock note. As documented, [task-detail-lock-issue-otp] is correctly HIDDEN because isOwner=true (backend 400 'Kendi görevinize...' would be raised, so UI hides the button — matches spec). Cross-role OTP + verify path not exercisable on a single admin+owner account (documented in prompt). No crashes, no red screens, no 401s. Only warning: pre-existing 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from react-native-web (not caused by Wave 3/4).
